chapter_seo_title: The Xia Emperor's Vigil & Ji Ning's Half-Year Void Drift – Desolate Era Chapter 465
chapter_meta_description: The Xia Emperor confirms Ji Ning survived Karmic Hellfire. While the Black-White College guards his Life Tablet, Ji Ning drifts through the void, honing his archery—until a vast continent appears.
og_title: Chapter 465: The Vigil and the Void – A Desperate Wait Across Two Worlds
og_description: The Xia Emperor, the Celestial Fox, and the Diancai Immortal piece together Ji Ning’s fate. Meanwhile, in the endless dark, Ji Ning trains in archery until a distant land beckons.
twitter_title: Ji Ning Survived Hellfire, but Where Is He? Chapter 465 Breakdown
twitter_description: The Shaoyin clan panics. The Black-White College seals its halls. And Ji Ning, after six months adrift, spots a colossal continent ahead.

lore_anchors.definition: A fox-type Immortal retainer serving the Xia Emperor; acts as a spy and intelligence agent.
A supreme divination treasure that allows the user to observe any event occurring within the known world in real-time.
Elite troops of the Grand Xia Dynasty, deployed to handle the sudden emergence of ancient Fiendgods.
A rare Dao-talisman capable of instant, cross-world teleportation—useless only in void or sealed realms.
An innate spirit treasure of the Shaoyin clan; can tear through space and teleport a target to a predetermined death-world anywhere in the void.
The eternally dark, storm-ravaged void between the Three Realms and the broader Chaosverse; it is cold, empty, and devoid of all Dao resonance.
The divine bow Ji Ning used to practice archery in the void; named after the asura demon Rahu.
The legendary archery divine ability passed down from the supreme archer Houyi, combining divine power circulation with Heartforce for causality-breaking precision.
A divine ability derived from the primordial Torch Dragon (Zhulong), gathering all ambient light into the user’s pupils for extreme long-range vision.
The consummate mental state of perfect, unshakable calm and clarity—Ji Ning’s Heartforce training has brought him to near-completion of this realm, making his archery far more lethal.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why can’t Ji Ning sense the Dao in the void?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Realm of Annihilation is a domain of pure, empty space with no active Heavenly Dao or natural elements; without the Dao’s resonance, a cultivator cannot comprehend new insights.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why didn’t the Xia Emperor save Ji Ning?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Emperor witnessed the battle through his Perfect Mirror but remained neutral—the Shaoyin clan is his vassal, and his official position forced him to act only when Fiendgods appeared, not to intervene in a private blood feud.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is a Life Tablet (命简)?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It’s a soul-linked jade slip that shatters upon its owner’s death, granting instant confirmation of fate. Ji Ning’s intact tablet assures his allies he still lives.
Not immediately. The continent he just discovered is likely another mysterious realm or death-world, setting up a new arc of exploration.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Ji Ning only practice archery in the void?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Without the Dao, he cannot cultivate insight-based arts. Archery, powered by Heartforce and divine power mechanics, can be trained purely through repetition and will.
